notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1790). Words follow the Peters engraving's spelling and punctuation: quell' ira as two words (kwell + ˈi.ra), nè, Dorabella's “se cresce il mio furor” (without più), Despina's “si cangerà” (bars 153–170; si reflexive, “it will turn”), and the officers' aside “Dalla voglia ch'ho di ridere” in bars 94–102 (its bracket not closed in the print). IPA, word meanings and translations come from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts (L37, IPA checked against Castel), repeated where the score repeats the text; repeated fragments have short literal translations. IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions (two words on one note in the score) joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ. Translation literal, for meaning.
